note: All three runs are infrastructure-failed and are EXCLUDED from any model-quality inference or promotion claim. They are preserved in the scratch evidence directory; this summary is the committed record. Campaign 1 was killed by a process/session restart and is unresumable (empty attempt index, exhausted absolute campaign deadline). Campaign 2 completed all 512 arms but the campaign-level capacity caps (N5-era values) were exhausted after ~72 arms, after which every arm was refused budget and terminated model_error -> 220/256 pairs invalid-arm. Campaign 3 completed all 512 arms under the amended caps and finalized 255/256 pairs: a single control-case baseline arm was invalidated by the E1-02 out-of-workspace sentinel (status=error, failureCategory=infrastructure, so isStrictValidArm=false), which alone makes the frozen judge's infrastructure_qualified and full_frozen_grid gates fail. Campaign 3 produced the first real judged record of this round and is archived under docs/evidence/agent-next7-20261006/execution/main (verdict NOT_PROVEN); its gate observations are descriptive only. See N7-RESULT-20261007.md for the result record and the three measurement defects this run exposed.
